_comment: Roster page per school, keyed by the same normalized team name
update-seed.py's norm_team() produces: lower-cased, dots removed,
'state' shortened to 'st'. There is no pattern to athletics domains
(kuathletics.com, uhcougars.com, goshockers.com), so this map is written
by hand and verified by the scrape log rather than guessed at runtime.
The path is not uniform either: most schools use /sports/womens-volleyball/,
but UCF uses /sports/volleyball/. Guessing the domain is not enough - each
entry has to be confirmed against the log.
A team missing from this map is skipped, never an error.
'unverified' holds an entry whose URL has not yet been confirmed by a run.
It is read exactly like 'verified'; the split only records what we know.
Move an entry up once the log shows it parsing - Grand Canyon went up
this way, 20 players on its first run.
Arizona St. and Texas Tech were long recorded here as unfixable, on the
grounds that their servers never send the roster. That was wrong, or has
stopped being true: the saved pages in scraped/roster-miss-*.txt both
carry the full roster as rendered text. What failed was the parser -
Texas Tech writes one player per tab-separated line, and Arizona St. puts
the name above the number with a hometown that reads like a name. Both
shapes are handled now and covered by scripts/roster-parser.test.mjs.
